versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Content Strategy skill.

- Provides a complete playbook for solopreneurs to plan, create, and distribute effective content.
- Covers setting content goals, audience research, defining content pillars, and selecting formats/channels.
- Includes guidance on building a content calendar, distribution strategies, and repurposing workflows.
- Offers specific recommendations and examples for solopreneurs.
- Details key metrics to measure content performance and optimize results.
